head: 98e388f1
headSubject: feat(cli,manager): Wave 7.2 -- the Manager's Evals tab
summary: Wave 7 of the close-all-open plan, all three sub-items: 7.3 reactivated the trusted-source-path-traversal scenario -- the ai-model schema pattern already rejected a traversal entrypoint, but the generator's own UntrustedExtensionManifest resolved a manifest-declared relativePath with plain Path.resolve+normalize, blind to a symlink whose real target lands outside the model's source root; added resolveWithinSourceRoot() (syntactic guard + toRealPath comparison) at every read site, two regression tests (one proving a real symlink escape is caught), and corrected beta0-scope.json/maturity-score-policy.json to stop calling the scenario deferred. 7.1 added npdev eval run/compare/list-scenarios/list-runs/stop: a headless eval harness over NPDevSamples/ai-scenarios/*/ that routes each scenario to whichever existing engine can answer it (run-ai-schema-validation.ps1 for schema/config/command-policy/verification-schema stages, run-ai-beta-gate.ps1's full normalize-generate-build-boot-smoke pipeline -- which gained an optional -Scenario filter -- for anything needing a real boot), writing a uniform <BuildRoot>/evals/<run-id>/results.json with incremental per-scenario writes and a cooperative CANCELLED-sentinel stop. 7.2 built the Manager's Evals tab (evals.js/evals.css, 5 Tauri commands, 4 live-captured fixtures, version bumped to 0.4.3) on top of 7.1. Also fixed two unrelated pre-existing bugs found along the way: idp-github's unit tests were never wired into either CI workflow (mirrored idp-google's existing line), and three scripts (check-firstrun-extractor.py, check-ops-script-names.py, build_core_context.py) still built paths against the pre-migration content/ dir instead of docs/content/ -- one crashed the whole ai-knowledge gate, one passed vacuously checking zero files.
nextStep: Start Wave 8 (WmsOffice GeneXus parity) of D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\NPDEV_FEATURE_PLAN_2026-09-24.md: 8.1 write parity.json for AppGen/apps/_official/WmsOffice (app-definition layer, outside this repo), Origem/Destino first; 8.2 close platform gaps against it. Read the wave's own Inspect step first.
blocked: None new. Two pre-existing, already-documented gaps remain open and were NOT touched: canary-build-boot-smoke's stale API key (build+health pass, only REST smoke's key is stale -- same as the prior two sessions' handoffs) and, newly confirmed via this session's gate runs, SEC-13's ledger guard.ref (kind:script citing a .java file path + a pytest ::method-style path, neither of which check-done-item-guards.py's resolve_script() accepts) and 2 stale SqlDialect-method-allowlist entries in check-dialect-methods-are-asked.py -- both confirmed present in the FIRST gate run of this session before any of my edits, so pre-existing and out of Wave 7's scope, but worth a dedicated session.
verified: 7.3: UntrustedExtensionSecurityHardeningTest (8/8 incl. 2 new) green; run-ai-schema-validation.ps1 still passes the reactivated scenario. 7.1: full NPDevCli suite (903 then 914 tests across the session) green; real end-to-end runs of both the light path (schema-only, ~2s once scenario-filtered) and the full heavy path (base-ai-loop: real generate+build+boot+REST-smoke, ~169s, verdict PASS); a real multi-scenario cancellation test showed 1 completed + 3 correctly SKIPPED_CANCELLED. 7.2: cargo check clean (0 warnings) after every edit; check-manager-version-bump.py passes; all 4 fixtures captured live from the real CLI; could NOT click-test the Tauri GUI itself in this headless environment (same limitation the prior session's Studio tab hit) -- verified by hand-tracing field names across the CLI JSON / Rust wrappers / fixtures / evals.js instead. Ran the fast gate (T1) at the end: the only real failure is the pre-existing canary API-key issue; the two OVERDUE items (check-adr-decision-implementation, shell-scenarios-golden-browser) are cadence-staleness flags, not failures caused by this session.
